build_common_tools_justification: The package uses standard npm scripts and the TypeScript compiler.
build_floss_tools_justification: Node.js, npm, TypeScript, and all build dependencies are FLOSS.
build_justification: npm run build compiles the TypeScript package from source.
contribution_requirements_justification: https://github.com/udid-tools/device-info/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md documents verification, test, documentation, changelog, source, compatibility, and privacy requirements.
crypto_call_justification: The runtime library implements no cryptography.
crypto_floss_justification: The runtime library implements no cryptography.
crypto_keylength_justification: The runtime library implements no cryptography or keys.
crypto_password_storage_justification: The runtime library stores no passwords or credentials.
crypto_pfs_justification: The runtime library performs no network communication or cryptography.
crypto_published_justification: The runtime library implements no cryptography.
crypto_random_justification: The runtime library generates no keys, nonces, tokens, or random values.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: The runtime library implements no cryptography.
crypto_working_justification: The runtime library implements no cryptography.
delivery_mitm_justification: npm and GitHub distribute releases over HTTPS with checksums, Sigstore bundles, and provenance attestations.
delivery_unsigned_justification: Checksums are downloaded over HTTPS and are also covered by a downloadable Sigstore verification bundle.
description: Offline TypeScript device-model and OS-build catalog for use with Apple devices.
description_good_justification: The README and https://udid-tools.github.io/device-info/ describe the package and the problem it solves.
discussion_justification: GitHub Issues and pull requests provide public, searchable, URL-addressable discussions: https://github.com/udid-tools/device-info/issues
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: All example-based and generated tests execute with Vitest assertions enabled.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: A failing test or generated property blocks required CI and must be fixed before merge or release.
dynamic_analysis_justification: The automated Vitest suite varies inputs and enforces 100% branch coverage, exceeding the criterion's 80% branch threshold.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: The package is written in memory-safe TypeScript and JavaScript and contains no native code.
english_justification: The source, documentation, issue forms, and contribution process are in English.
enhancement_responses_justification: There have been no qualifying external enhancement requests in the last 2-12 months.
interact_justification: The README explains installation and links to GitHub issue forms and CONTRIBUTING.md.
know_common_errors_justification: The threat model covers catalog poisoning, compromised automation or dependencies, credential compromise, untrusted input, and misleading unknown-value handling with explicit mitigations.
know_secure_design_justification: Primary maintainers author and enforce the least-privilege, fail-closed, minimal-attack-surface controls documented in https://github.com/udid-tools/device-info/blob/main/THREAT_MODEL.md
maintained_justification: The project has current releases, commits, automated maintenance, and maintainer-reviewed pull requests.
name: device-info
no_leaked_credentials_justification: GitHub secret scanning and push protection are enabled, publishing uses OIDC instead of npm tokens, and no valid private credential is committed.
release_notes_vulns_justification: There have been no publicly known vulnerabilities to identify in release notes.
repo_distributed_justification: Git is a distributed version-control system.
repo_interim_justification: Changes are committed to main through pull requests between numbered releases.
repo_track_justification: Git tracks every source change in the public GitHub repository.
report_responses_justification: There have been no qualifying external bug reports in the last 2-12 months; automated catalog issues were handled and closed.
sites_https_justification: The documentation, repository, npm registry, and GitHub Releases are HTTPS-only public endpoints.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL applies JavaScript and TypeScript security queries.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Confirmed exploitable medium-or-higher findings block release and must be fixed promptly; there are no open CodeQL vulnerability findings.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL with security-extended queries and type-aware ESLint run before release and on every pull request.
static_analysis_often_justification: Static analysis runs on every pull request and push to main and on a weekly schedule.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: https://github.com/udid-tools/device-info/actions/workflows/ci.yml runs the complete suite on pull requests and pushes to main.
test_invocation_justification: npm test is the standard npm test entry point.
test_justification: The public Vitest suite runs with npm test and is documented in https://github.com/udid-tools/device-info/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#development
test_most_justification: CI currently reports 100% line, statement, function, and branch coverage.
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md requires tests for new behavior and npm run verify for every change.
tests_are_added_justification: Recent catalog and behavior changes include tests, and coverage thresholds block untested behavior.
version_unique_justification: Each release has a unique package version, Git tag, GitHub Release, and npm version.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: There are no known critical vulnerabilities; critical issues are prioritized immediately.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: There are no publicly known unpatched medium-or-higher vulnerabilities.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability report has been received in the last six months.
warnings_fixed_justification: Lint and type errors fail required CI, so warnings must be fixed before merge.
warnings_justification: TypeScript strict mode and type-aware ESLint rules run in npm run verify.
warnings_strict_justification: The project enables TypeScript strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes, and typescript-eslint strict type-checked rules.
